question: Does the new training corpus have poorer fixed-motif designability than the original confidence-selected corpus?
selection: SHA256(seed:cohort:id), independent of confidence and refold outcomes; no replacements
primary: Raw-valid source with at least one same valid refold having global TM>0.5, scaffold-only TM>0.5, motif proper CA RMSD<=1A and dRMS<=1A
secondary: Raw-valid source with at least one valid global-TM>0.5 refold, irrespective of motif retention
statistics: Independent family bootstrap within length buckets; equal bucket weight; 10000 resamples; added minus original
scope: Training-only diagnostic, no evaluation or locked-test labels. All128 sources stay in denominators. Confidence associations are exploratory. This assay does not establish a training improvement or select a model.
